parsed.post: Huge jump in val_bpb (0.943874) after adopting agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. The model is significantly more performant with the extra shard. It looks like the model is benefiting heavily from more data. Next: I'll explore increasing DEPTH to 6 to increase capacity, as we have room to grow.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6, building on the new best configuration (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10').
